annotations.title: Tokenized stocks, pre-IPO shares and ETFs

description: Tokenized equities on public chains (xStocks, bStocks, Ondo Global Markets, Robinhood, Dinari, Coinbase and others): token price, market cap, 24h volume, the underlying ticker, chains, and (on Pro) premium or discount to the latest underlying quote. Filter by issuer, kind (stock, pre-ipo, etf), underlying or chain. Information only, not advice.

chain.description: Chain name as CoinGecko lists it, e.g. "solana", "arbitrum-one", "ethereum"

issuer.description: Issuer name or part of it, e.g. "xStocks", "Ondo", "Robinhood"

limit.description: Max rows (default 20; Free and anonymous up to 10, Pro up to 100)

sortBy.description: Default marketCap; premium sorts by absolute premium

name: list_tokenized_equities
title: Tokenized stocks, pre-IPO shares and ETFs
